ev.q: During 2000–2017, annual reported measles incidence decreased 83%, and annual estimated measles deaths decreased 80%.
A previously described model for estimating measles disease and mortality was updated with new measles vaccination coverage data
Globally, 118 (61%) countries achieved ≥90% MCV1 coverage in 2017
annual reported measles incidence decreased 83%, from 145 to 25 cases per million population
Globally, 118 (61%) countries achieved ≥90% MCV1 coverage in 2017
the largest increases in the percentage of countries with ≥90% MCV1 coverage were in AFR (from 9% to 34%) and SEAR (from 27% to 64%)
This report describes progress toward global measles control milestones and regional measles elimination goals during 2000–2017
During 2000–2017, estimated MCV1 coverage increased globally from 72% to 85%
Countries report the aggregate number of incident measles cases to WHO and UNICEF annually

methods_quotes.q: A previously described model for estimating measles disease and mortality was updated
For countries with previously anomalous estimates, the model was modified slightly to generate mortality estimates consistent with the observed case data
compared with no measles vaccination, measles vaccination prevented an estimated 21.1 million deaths globally
Any country not reporting data on measles cases for that year was removed from both the numerator and denominator.
Error bars represent upper and lower 95% confidence limits around the point estimate.
